- Interpreted replicated low-dose tub_mean z +16 to +30 and tub_glcm_contrast dose rho +0.81 as stabilizer bundling without testing that monopolar Eg5 spindles produce the same intensity/texture rise.

- Relied on intensity proxies and never measured spindle polarity or cell-free polymerization to distinguish Eg5 monopolar arrest from direct microtubule stabilization.

Proposed next experiment: High-resolution alpha-tubulin plus phospho-H3 and pericentrin/gamma-tubulin immunofluorescence to score monopolar versus bipolar/bundled spindles across doses, paired with a cell-free tubulin polymerization assay with paclitaxel and nocodazole controls to test for direct stabilization.
